is a reference whose target no longer resolves: the referenced Document was deleted, or it exists but isn't published (and Graph Traversal is published-only). The pointer still sits in the referrer's payload — the data isn't corrupt, the *target* is just gone.

. The Edge Projector simply never writes it. That means dangling-ness is not a flag on a row — there is no
column anywhere. It is derived: when traversal expands a referrer and the target won't resolve, it materializes a Phantom Node on the spot.
This read-time derivation is the key design choice. The write side stays clean and FK-safe; the read side does the honest accounting. A Reference Field that is
can dangle in just some slots — each unresolved slot becomes its own phantom.
